source.title: WCA Regulations — January 2020: Now in Effect
source.content: New WCA [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) and [Guidelines](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/guidelines.html) are in effect as of January 1, 2020. Please see the [original announcement](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/wca-regulations-january-2020) for details.

translation.title: 2020 年 1 月版 WCA 竞赛规则现已生效
translation.content: 新版 WCA [竞赛规则](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)与[指南](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/guidelines.html)已于 2020 年 1 月 1 日生效。详情请参阅[原公告](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/wca-regulations-january-2020)。
translation.revisionReason: 完成当前版本独立审校；正文未改。

review.scope: 完整英文标题及正文与当前中文逐篇语义对照；不包含外链正文或独立事实核验
notes: 全文核对规则变更条件、数字、项目中文、权限强度及链接。
